text:
maria: heads-up — opened PR with batching + attention-kernel tweaks that should reduce tail latency. can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/842

sam: on it, tagging @maria. i can check correctness and run the unit suite later today. any perf numbers to share?

maria: quick numbers from my dev rig (A100-ish): p50 ~18ms -> 16ms, p95 ~95ms -> 73ms for seq_len=512, batch=8. these are with continuous-batching enabled + small kernel change in attention.

lee: those p95 gains look promising. did you run the kv-cache scenario? last time batching interacted weirdly with sharded KV cache and increased mem pressure.

maria: yup — ran kv-shard test: no evictions, peak mem ~0.9x previous for the same workload. i left the flags in a local test harness: `./tools/bench --kv-shard --seq 512 --batch 8` and attached the logs in the PR.

ara: quick note — the config schema changed (added `batching.max_inflight`). need to update the migrations for Dedicated customers. is that included?

maria: good catch. added a tiny migration patch in the PR that defaults to previous behavior. also updated docs snippet under `config/batching.md`.

kevin: CI looks green except for one flaky integration test (`serve_load_test.go`). deploy-bot reran it once and it passed. would like 1 more +LGTM before merging during today's merge window (4pm PST).

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #842: unit ✅, e2e ✅, perf-check ✅ (artifact: perf-report-842.json)

sam: reading through code now. small nit: in `attention_kernel.cu` you use `atomicAdd` in a hot path — can we switch to warp intrinsics? i'll leave an inline comment.

maria: pushed a follow-up commit addressing that nit and added a microbenchmark. PTAL.

lee: reviewed the kv-cache changes, left two comments about null-check ordering. nothing blocking.

ara: migration looks fine to me. one doc wording suggestion in the console section.

sam: gave an approval after the atomic change patch.

kevin: approved. i'm going to schedule the merge for 4:05pm PST after the last perf artifact is uploaded. if anyone sees a regression in the next hour flag it here and i'll hold. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: thanks all — appreciate the quick reviews. i'll watch the canary after merge and open a rollback if the canary p95 goes above 120ms.

sam: thanks, will monitor infra dashboards too.

maria: merging now (will update thread with merge commit).

deploy-bot: merged PR #842 -> main (commit 9f3c2a7). canary rollout started in us-west-2.

maria: canary steady for 15m, p95 at ~75ms, no errors :thumbsup:

kevin: great — promoting to full rollout in 10.

maria: done. thanks everyone!
